item.title: NixOS
item.description:
Why?

Over the past 5 years I have had my fair share of changing laptops, setting up a new windows system, sideloading Ubuntu and more.

Naturally, the process is hard, effortful and forgetful!

So I was looking for a more declarative way of setting up things and that’s how I stumbled upon NixOS.
